commits.author: Guillaume Gay
commits.subject: Fix session resume failing with generic exit code 1
commits.body:
When a session no longer exists on Claude's side, the CLI returns
"No conversation found" via stderr and exits with code 1. However,
the SDK hardcodes a generic error message instead of capturing the
real stderr, so the bot never saw the actual reason.

Two fixes:
- Add stderr callback to ClaudeAgentOptions so real CLI errors are
  captured and logged instead of "Check stderr output for details"
- Widen the resume retry logic to catch any error during session
  resume (not just the specific "no conversation found" string that
  was never matched), automatically cleaning up the stale session
  and retrying with a fresh one

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: Richard A
commits.subject: Replace ToolMonitor with SDK can_use_tool callback (Phase 3)
commits.body:
Replace reactive tool validation (ToolMonitor intercepting stream callbacks)
with the SDK's preventive can_use_tool callback that blocks tools before
execution.

Changes:
- Add _make_can_use_tool_callback() in sdk_integration.py for file path
  and bash directory boundary validation via SecurityValidator
- Wire can_use_tool into ClaudeAgentOptions, accept SecurityValidator in
  ClaudeSDKManager.__init__()
- Switch from async-with to connect()/disconnect() pattern (required by
  SDK for can_use_tool support)
- Delete ToolMonitor class from monitor.py (keep check_bash_directory_boundary)
- Remove facade stream_handler wrapper, tool validation logic, admin
  instructions helper, and error message builder
- Remove ClaudeToolValidationError from exceptions and all catch sites
- Remove tool_monitor parameter from ClaudeIntegration and main.py
- Update tests: add can_use_tool callback tests, remove ToolMonitor tests,
  update mock client patterns to connect/disconnect

Net ~416 lines removed (668 deletions, 252 additions).
